title: Comparison of large language models and expert multidisciplinary team decisions in colorectal cancer

live_model.evidence: "Three LLMs-OpenAI o3-mini-2025-01-31, DeepSeek-R1 671b and Qwen qwq-plus-2025-03-05-were tested"; concordance with MDT consensus=65.4% for O3 (n=971 consistent cases)

prompt.location: "details in online supplemental methods"; Figure 1 depicts the structured multirole prompt conceptually
prompt.note: The literal multirole MDT-simulation prompt is not reproduced in the main text.

claim.metric: concordance rate with expert MDT consensus
claim.location: Results: "agreement rates were 65.4% for O3"; 971 of 1423 cases with consistent outputs across 3 runs

data.source: 1423 colorectal cancer MDT records from Peking University Cancer Hospital (Jan 2023-Dec 2024), real patient data

notes: Each of 1423 cases run 3x (4,269 calls) to check consistency; only 971 O3 cases had consistent outputs and entered the formal concordance analysis. DeepSeek-R1 671b and QwQ-plus-2025-03-05 run identically for comparison.
